facts.fact: Lady Justice Immaculate Busingye said ECCMIS is locally developed by Judiciary staff, and members of its Technical Committee and the Judiciary's Senior Systems Administrator supported the training and the system.

systems.tiers: 42 court stations in and around Kampala

facts.fact: Justice Musa Ssekaana said ECCMIS has been rolled out to 42 court stations within and around Kampala, with Cluster 8 courts including Mbarara High Court to follow in May 2026.
Justice Ssekaana said "cases are filed electronically" on ECCMIS, whose training covered case registration and filing and e-payments.
